rv.q: By the show's end, one feels not merely entertained, but converted—a joyful initiate in Goodman's glittering gospel of self-love.
Goodman, it turns out, is a genuinely magnetic priest, and their enthusiasm and vulnerability make their ennobling message worth hearing yet again.

cn.t: Brandon Kyle Goodman delivers a bold, sex-positive one-person show that upends religious shame with defiant liberation. Critics praise its gloriously irreverent energy, though responses range from ecstatic to more measured appreciation.
